title: Extending a live price round to a later end is accepted and becomes the round's end time
preconditions: Session: the BUYER (owner of the sandbox). The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single price round {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids.
steps: 1. PATCH /trade/{{tradeId}} with a new end of 1 Jan 2030 00:00 UTC and a remark.
2. Read the round: its end time must be 1 Jan 2030 00:00 UTC.
expectedResult: HTTP 200; the round's ending_at becomes 1893456000 — before_save set_bid_end_time copies the last rfq schedule end into the stored column (app/models/trade_request.rb:277, 828-838, 3096-3098).
rationale: Lists, filters and reminders read the stored end; it must equal the live schedule after an extension.
notes: Acts only on the run's own sandbox copy; the far end keeps the copy open, it never touches a real event.

title: Opening a live price round returns its settings with the indicator set filled in
preconditions: Session: the BUYER (owner of the sandbox). The sandbox event ({{eventGroupUuid}}) is published, its single price round {{tradeId}} is open, one line item, no bids.
steps: 2. In the settings block, other_auction_indicators_config lists every optional indicator (missing ones as false).
rationale: The vendor's indicator cards are drawn from this block; a missing key hides an indicator the buyer switched on.
